# glpi_datacenter_room (Resource)

GLPI data center room.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_datacenter" "main" {
  name = "Main data center"
}

resource "glpi_datacenter_room" "hall_1" {
  name          = "Hall 1"
  datacenter_id = glpi_datacenter.main.id
  columns       = 9
  rows          = 23
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item.

### Optional

- `cell_height` (Number) Height of a grid cell in the rack view. Needs GLPI 11 or later.
- `cell_width` (Number) Width of a grid cell in the rack view. Needs GLPI 11 or later.
- `columns` (Number) Number of grid columns in the room's rack view.
- `datacenter_id` (Number) ID of the data center that holds the room.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `location_id` (Number) ID of the location.
- `rows` (Number) Number of grid rows in the room's rack view.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_datacenter_room.example 42
```
